description: Plan VIII Task 24.7 — flake quarantine registry. A quarantined gate still RUNS; a quarantined failure is flagged QUARANTINED in the summary and JSON report and does not by itself fail the run. Rules: max duration 14 days from added date; every entry needs owner, reason, and tracking note; Core-invariant gates (protected_gates) can never be quarantined — the runner rejects such entries; expired entries are ignored (the gate's failure then fails the run like any other).
